language.footer: Used for new meetings. Auto follows both languages in one meeting.

error.busy: A recording or import is running. Try again when it finishes.
error.offline: Strict offline mode is on, so nothing can be sent or downloaded.
error.noModel: Download the voice model first (Settings → Models).
error.micPermission: Microphone access is off. Turn it on in Settings.
error.busyRecording: A recording is running. Finish it first.
error.tooShort: That was too short. Read the whole passage.
error.tooQuiet: Too quiet. Move closer and try again.
error.noAuthMethod: Turn on a passcode in Settings to use app lock.

models.title: Models
models.footer: Models run on this phone. They are downloaded once and never sent anywhere.

voice.title: Voice profile
voice.footer: The profile stays encrypted on this phone. Delete it any time.
voice.noModel: The voice model isn’t downloaded yet. Get it in Models.
voice.deleteConfirm: Delete your voice profile? Your voice samples are erased for good and can’t be recovered.

consent.title: Consent message
consent.footer: Shown when you start recording so you can tell people. Leave empty to use the built-in text.

cloud.title: Cloud notes
cloud.footer: Only transcript text is ever sent, never audio, and only after you preview and confirm it for one meeting.
cloud.redactDefault: Hide names and personal data by default
cloud.keyFooter: Stored in this phone’s Keychain. It is never shown again.

about.title: About
about.licencesFooter: Full license texts ship with the app.

privacy.title: Privacy and security
privacy.networkFooter: {{app}} only goes online for model downloads and cloud notes you confirm.
privacy.retentionFooter: When audio expires it is deleted. Transcripts and notes stay.
privacy.exportAllHint: An encrypted archive of every meeting.

deleteAll.title: Delete everything?
deleteAll.body: Every meeting, voice profile, key and setting on this phone is erased for good. This can’t be undone.

export.title: Export everything
export.body: Pick a password. Without it the file can’t be opened, and anyone with both gets every meeting.

lock.title: {{app}} is locked
lock.body: Your meetings stay private until you unlock.

cloudSheet.title: Improve with cloud
cloudSheet.intro: Only the transcript text leaves this phone, never audio. You see exactly what is sent before anything goes.
cloudSheet.redactionOffWarn: Names and personal data will be sent as written.
cloudSheet.locked: Cloud is off for this meeting (“Never send to cloud”). Turn that option off in the meeting’s options to send.
cloudSheet.sent: Notes were rewritten with the cloud.
cloudSheet.failed: The cloud didn’t answer, so your notes stay on this phone.
cloudSheet.failedLeft: The request may already have reached {{provider}}.
cloudSheet.warningsIntro: This still looks like personal data:
